author: Mpzx9720
quote: Absolute hot garbage, this pales in comparison to what true GTA used be. This is trash. Mission after mission of you running errands or trying to make Lucia “happy” barely any shoot outs, heists or actual substance resembling GTA. Can’t even steal cars the first 4-7 hours of gameplay. Literally stopped playing due to how angry this game made me because of how much of a soy boy they made Jason and all the focus on their relationship. This was supposed to be GRAND THEFT AUTO, not cuck relationship simulator. If I wanted that, I would play Sims. We waited 13 years for this slop **** and they ruined it with all their soft politically correct garbage.
